inflammation.title: Reduced Inflammation
inflammation.desc: Eliminating plant toxins and seed oils can dramatically lower systemic inflammation, helping with joint pain and autoimmune conditions.

autophagy.title: Autophagy & Cellular Renewal
autophagy.desc: Your body activates powerful self-healing mechanisms, recycling damaged cells and regenerating new ones. Many report looking and feeling up to 10 years younger as their body repairs from the inside out.
autophagy.q: Interested in learning more about autophagy?

clarity.title: Mental Clarity
clarity.desc: Stable blood sugar and ketones fuel the brain efficiently, leading to sharper focus and reduced brain fog.

fatloss.title: Fat Loss
fatloss.desc: High protein and fat satiety naturally reduces caloric intake. Many report effortless weight loss without counting calories.
fatloss.q: Is fat loss a priority for you?

gut.title: Gut Healing
gut.desc: Removing fiber and plant irritants allows the gut lining to heal, improving digestion and nutrient absorption.

energy.title: Sustained Energy
energy.desc: No sugar crashes. Fat-adapted metabolism provides steady energy throughout the day.

hormones_f.title: Women's Hormonal Balance
hormones_f.desc: Many women experience vanishing period pain, lighter and more predictable cycles, and a stable, consistent hormonal rhythm — often within the first few months.

testosterone.title: Testosterone Optimization
testosterone.desc: Red meat and animal fats provide the cholesterol and zinc essential for testosterone production. Many men report improved drive, confidence, and vitality within weeks.

lean_muscle.title: Lean Muscle & Body Composition
lean_muscle.desc: High bioavailable protein fuels muscle protein synthesis while naturally reducing body fat. Men often notice a harder, more defined physique without strict gym protocols.

clean.title: Eating Incredibly Clean
clean.desc: Zero sugars, zero preservatives, no artificial colours or flavours. Your body receives pure, whole-animal nutrition exactly as nature intended — nothing processed, nothing synthetic.
clean.q: Does clean eating matter to you?

glow.title: Overall Glow-Up
glow.desc: Beyond clearing acne, eczema, and psoriasis — many experience brighter eyes, thicker hair, stronger nails, and a radiant complexion that reflects deep internal health.
glow.q: Noticed any skin or hair changes?

no_counting.title: Forget Calorie Counting Forever
no_counting.desc: High-protein, high-fat meals naturally regulate appetite and satiety hormones. Most people effortlessly eat the right amount — no tracking apps, no food scales, no mental math.
no_counting.q: Do you enjoy not counting calories?

sports.title: Higher Sports Performance
sports.desc: Fat-adapted athletes report improved endurance, faster recovery, and greater explosive power. Reduced inflammation means less downtime between training sessions.

stress.title: Stress Resistance
stress.desc: Stable blood sugar and optimized hormones build a resilient nervous system. Many report handling pressure with calm focus instead of anxiety and burnout.

items.title: "Red meat causes heart disease"
items.content: This claim is based on outdated epidemiological studies that conflated processed meats with fresh cuts. Modern meta-analyses show no significant link between unprocessed red meat and cardiovascular disease. Saturated fat from whole foods raises large, buoyant LDL — the harmless kind.

items.title: "You'll get scurvy without fruit"
items.content: Fresh meat contains enough vitamin C to prevent scurvy. The requirement drops dramatically on a low-carb diet because glucose and vitamin C compete for the same cellular transporters. Inuit populations thrived for millennia on meat-only diets without deficiency.

items.title: "Fiber is essential for digestion"
items.content: Multiple studies show that reducing or eliminating fiber can improve constipation, bloating, and IBS symptoms. The gut doesn't require fiber — it adapts to an all-meat diet by producing less bulk and absorbing nutrients more efficiently.

items.title: "Too much protein damages kidneys"
items.content: In healthy individuals, high protein intake does not impair kidney function. This myth originated from studies on people with pre-existing kidney disease. Your kidneys are designed to filter protein — that's literally their job.

items.title: "You need carbs for energy"
items.content: The body can produce all the glucose it needs through gluconeogenesis. Fat-adapted individuals run on ketones — a cleaner, more stable fuel source. Many elite athletes perform at peak levels on zero-carb diets.

items.title: "Cholesterol from meat is dangerous"
items.content: Dietary cholesterol has minimal impact on blood cholesterol for most people. The liver produces 80% of your cholesterol regardless of diet. Cholesterol is essential for hormone production, cell membranes, and brain function.

items.title: "Plants are the healthiest foods"
items.content: Plants contain anti-nutrients (oxalates, lectins, phytates) that can impair mineral absorption and trigger inflammation. Animal foods provide the most bioavailable forms of iron, zinc, B12, and essential amino acids with zero anti-nutrients.

items.title: "Carnivore is just a fad diet"
items.content: Humans have been primarily carnivorous for 2+ million years. The agricultural revolution (grains, sugar) is only 10,000 years old. Carnivore isn't new — it's a return to how our species evolved to eat.

guide.title: Complete Guide
guide.subtitle: A comprehensive guide to carnivore eating · 7 sections

whatIs.title: What is the Carnivore Diet?
whatIs.content: The carnivore diet is an elimination diet consisting exclusively of animal products. It removes all plant foods, focusing on meat, fish, eggs, and sometimes dairy. By stripping away potential irritants, it lets your body heal and reveals which foods your system truly tolerates.

foodsToEat.title: Foods to Eat
items: Beef: Steaks, roasts, ground beef, organs
Pork: Chops, bacon, shoulder, belly
Lamb: Chops, leg, ground lamb
Poultry: Chicken, turkey, duck
Fish: Salmon, sardines, mackerel
Eggs: Any style, as many as desired
Dairy: Butter, cheese, cream (if tolerated)
Organs: Liver, heart, kidney — nature's multivitamins

foodsToAvoid.title: Foods to Avoid
foodsToAvoid.q: Helpful to know what to cut?
items: All vegetables and fruits
Grains and legumes
Nuts and seeds
Vegetable and seed oils
Sugar and sweeteners
Processed foods of any kind

whyTry.q: Do any of these resonate with you?
items: Autoimmune conditions

Weight loss and body recomposition
Mental health and clarity
Elimination diet approach
Simplicity — no counting, no planning

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
items: 1. Clear out non-carnivore foods from your kitchen
2. Stock up on quality meats — prioritize ruminants
3. Commit to 30 days minimum for a fair trial
4. Track how you feel daily (energy, mood, digestion)
5. Adjust fat-to-protein ratio based on your response

disclaimer.title: Medical Disclaimer
disclaimer.content: Consult your healthcare provider before starting any new dietary approach, especially if you have pre-existing conditions or take medications. This guide is educational — not medical advice.

cravings.title: Combat Cravings
cravings.intro: Cravings are your body detoxing from sugar and carbs. Here's how to push through:

fat.title: Eat More Fat
fat.desc: Cravings often mean you're not eating enough. Add butter, tallow, or fatty cuts. Your body craves energy — give it animal fat, not sugar.
fat.q: Will you try eating more fat?

hydrate.title: Stay Hydrated + Electrolytes
hydrate.desc: Drink water with salt, magnesium, and potassium. Low electrolytes mimic sugar cravings. Bone broth is an excellent source.
hydrate.q: Do you keep up with electrolytes?

coffee.title: Black Coffee or Tea
coffee.desc: Caffeine can help suppress appetite during adaptation. Keep it black — no sweeteners. This helps bridge the gap in early weeks.

sleep.title: Prioritize Sleep
sleep.desc: Poor sleep spikes ghrelin (hunger hormone) and lowers leptin. Aim for 7-9 hours. This alone can eliminate most cravings.

withdrawal.title: Understand the Withdrawal
withdrawal.desc: Sugar is addictive. Withdrawal symptoms peak at days 3-5 and fade by week 2-3. It's temporary — your brain is rewiring.
withdrawal.q: Are you past the withdrawal phase?

temptation.title: Remove All Temptation
temptation.desc: Clear your kitchen of non-carnivore foods. Don't rely on willpower. Make the right choice the only choice available.

sustain.title: Sustain Results
sustain.intro: Long-term success requires more than willpower. Build systems that make carnivore your default.

goals.title: Set Non-Scale Goals
goals.desc: Track energy, sleep quality, mental clarity, and strength gains — not just weight. These victories keep motivation alive long-term.

prep.title: Meal Prep Weekly
prep.desc: Cook in bulk on weekends. Pre-cooked ground beef, hard-boiled eggs, and pre-seasoned steaks make compliance effortless during busy weeks.

rotate.title: Rotate Your Proteins
rotate.desc: Avoid food fatigue by rotating beef, lamb, pork, seafood, and organ meats. Variety within carnivore keeps meals exciting.
rotate.q: Do you rotate your protein sources?

community.title: Join a Community
community.desc: Connect with other carnivores online or locally. Accountability and shared experiences make the lifestyle feel natural, not restrictive.
community.q: Are you part of a community?

track.title: Track Your Progress
track.desc: Take monthly photos, track body measurements, and log how you feel. Reviewing progress during tough weeks reignites motivation.

lifestyle.title: Embrace It as Lifestyle
lifestyle.desc: This isn't a 30-day challenge — it's how humans ate for millennia. Shift your mindset from 'diet' to 'the way I eat.' Sustainability follows identity.
lifestyle.q: Have you made the mindset shift?

gettingStarted.title: Your First 30 Days
gettingStarted.subtitle: A week-by-week roadmap for your carnivore journey · 5 sections

week1.title: Week 1: The Clean Slate
items: Empty your pantry of all non-animal foods
Stock up on beef, salt, butter, and eggs
Eat until satisfied — no calorie counting yet
Expect headaches and low energy (totally normal)
Drink plenty of water with a pinch of salt

week2.title: Week 2: Riding the Wave
items: Energy levels may swing up and down
Bump up salt intake if you feel foggy or tired
Sleep might be lighter — it settles soon
Cravings hit their peak, then start fading
Keep meals simple: steak, eggs, repeat

week3.title: Week 3: Finding Your Groove
items: Energy starts to stabilize noticeably
Digestion settles into a new rhythm
Appetite begins to self-regulate naturally
Many report improved mental focus here
Skin and joint improvements may appear

week4.title: Week 4: Optimization Mode
items: Try different cuts and animal sources
Introduce organ meats for nutrient density
Dial in your ideal fat-to-protein ratio
Reflect on how your body and mind feel overall
Decide your path forward: strict or relaxed

tips.title: Survival Tips
tips.q: Will you try any of these?
items: Keep electrolytes handy — salt, magnesium, potassium
Embrace the fat — it's your new fuel source
Simplicity wins: don't overcomplicate meals early on
Journal your symptoms, energy, and mood daily
Commit to the full 30 days before judging results

warning.title: Adaptation Warning
warning.content: The first 1–2 weeks can feel rough as your body switches fuel sources. This is temporary. Flu-like symptoms, digestive changes, and fatigue are common during adaptation and not a sign something is wrong.

athletic.title: Athletic Performance
athletic.subtitle: How carnivore fuels strength, endurance, and recovery · 7 sections

adapt.title: The Adaptation Phase
adapt.q: Are you in the adaptation phase?
items: Allow 2–6 weeks for full fat adaptation
Initial performance may dip — this is temporary
Endurance typically rebounds and often exceeds baseline
Strength athletes may need slightly higher protein
Don't judge performance during the transition period

pre.title: Pre-Training Fueling
items: Eat your main meal 2–3 hours before training
Focus on easily digestible proteins like eggs or ground beef
Some athletes thrive training completely fasted
Avoid heavy fatty cuts right before intense sessions
Experiment to find your personal sweet spot

post.title: Post-Workout Recovery
items: Prioritize a protein-rich meal within 2 hours
Ribeye or strip steak is an excellent recovery meal
Don't skimp on fat — it supports hormone recovery
Salt your food generously to replenish electrolytes
Bone broth is a great recovery drink alternative

endurance.title: Endurance Sports
items: Fat adaptation provides a near-unlimited fuel tank
No more bonking from glycogen depletion mid-race
Steady energy without the sugar crash roller coaster
Ultra-endurance athletes report best results on carnivore
Some elite competitors add targeted carbs for peak events

strength.title: Strength & Muscle Building
strength.q: Is this data useful for your training?

benefits.title: Strength Training Benefits
items: Recovery time often shortens on carnivore
Joint pain and inflammation frequently decrease
Better sleep quality supports muscle growth
Reduced bloating means better body composition visibility
Stable blood sugar eliminates energy crashes mid-session

note.title: Performance Note
note.content: If you compete at an elite level, work with a sports-aware practitioner familiar with low-carb athletics. Individual needs vary significantly based on sport type, intensity, and training volume.

personalTips.loseWeight_light: Add 2-3 HIIT sessions per week alongside your walking. Fat will melt off on carnivore.
personalTips.loseWeight_active: Your activity level is great for fat loss. Mix strength training with HIIT for maximum results.
personalTips.buildMuscle: Focus on strength training 4-5x/week. Carnivore provides the protein — you provide the effort.
personalTips.maintain: Keep a balanced mix of strength, cardio, and recovery. Consistency beats intensity.
personalTips.health_sedentary: Start gentle — yoga, walking, and breathwork. Movement is medicine, especially on carnivore.
personalTips.health_active: Pair your workouts with recovery practices. Yoga and meditation amplify carnivore's healing effects.
